note: Shared API fixtures. IDs are the shared fixture IDs. The fingerprint in viewer_schema_*.json is the real Fingerprint() of the snapshot, checked by backend/internal/database. Mock handlers and Go/TS tests read these files instead of copying payloads.

files.access_*: Access administration validation and policy errors.
files.auth_*: Current user, CSRF token, and unauthenticated responses.
files.connections_*: Connection administration responses and validation errors.
files.viewer_*: Schema, table data, and viewer error responses.
files.explain_*: Execution plans and unsupported statement errors.
files.users_*: User administration list and validation errors.
files.groups_*: Groups with leaders, members, grants and leader errors.
files.reviews_*: Change requests with live approvals and approval errors.
